form.title: Enter New PIN
form.info: Please choose a new 6-digit numeric PIN and enter your current PIN for confirmation.
form.confirmation: The PIN has been successfully changed.

confirm.title: Note Your PIN
confirm.info: Please make a note of the newly defined PIN. It replaces the previous one and will be required for login and verification from now on.
confirm.check: Yes, I have noted my PIN.

go_to_card.title: Change PIN
go_to_card.body: You can change your personal PIN if you wish – this is optional but possible if needed. The new PIN will replace your previous one.
